panels.alt: A student stands on a city rooftop beside an empty garden bed.
panels.bubbleText: This roof could become a garden for everyone.
panels.simplifiedExplanation: The student has an idea: people can grow plants together on the roof.

vocabulary.definition: The outside surface on top of a building.
A place where people grow plants.

panels.alt: Two neighbors carry small plant pots toward the rooftop garden.
panels.bubbleText: We can share the work and the vegetables.
panels.simplifiedExplanation: The neighbors agree to help. They will work together and share what they grow.

vocabulary.definition: To use or have something together with other people.
Plants that people grow and eat.

panels.alt: The neighbors pick vegetables from a thriving rooftop garden.
panels.bubbleText: Our small garden has brought the block together.
panels.simplifiedExplanation: The garden gives the neighbors food and helps them become a closer community.

vocabulary.definition: A group of buildings in a city.
People who live or work in the same area.

checks.prompt: What do the neighbors grow on the roof?
Complete the bubble: “We can ____ the work.”
Why did the garden bring the neighbors together?
options: They worked and shared food together.
